protocol: 24 regression queries, 3 repetitions, paired alternating order; 8 identical seeded trails; warmed local models; same CPU and checkout; no provider calls
timing_isolation: All live model trials and tests had finished before this local timing run; only the paired local benchmark used the retrieval models.
quality_scope: Seeded warm retrieval fixture; 72 paired responses compared excluding created_at/checks. A separate main-trial replay has 23/24 exact full-response matches; the single intentional change replaces off-topic validation evidence with a miss. Live subject-model correctness is reported separately.
limitations: One fixed repository regression suite with three repetitions, not held-out production workloads.
Bootstrap describes variation across these fixed task IDs; it is not a production guarantee.
Measured latency includes warm retrieval only; startup and push/indexing costs are excluded.
